enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Finish eating. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Open bag. Put in wallet. Put in keys. Close bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at red light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Use stethoscope. Take notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Use computer to update records. Talk to colleague. Take phone call. Attend meeting.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select sandwich. Select fruit. Select drink. Pay at cashier. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink beverage. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Pick up tray. Walk to trash can. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

Return to work area. Check messages. Walk to patient room. Check patient. Administer medication. Write notes. Use computer. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Talk to patient family. Update records. Prepare discharge papers. Walk to next patient.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Stand up.
Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type password. Open browser. Browse internet. Check email. Type email. Send email. Open document. Edit document. Save document. Close laptop.

Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll through feed. Tap on video. Watch video. Type comment. Send message. Play game. Adjust pillow. Turn off light. Continue using phone. Put down phone. Close eyes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Stretch legs. Turn again. Continue sleeping.
